# Integrations, payments and costs: build rules

Apply these rules while you build. Domains or criteria whose `applies_if` flags are false in `.quality/project.json` do not apply to this project. Before you call a task done, check your work against the criteria of the domains you touched: each one must be true and verifiable.

If a stack module of Shipwright is installed (sw-nextjs, sw-node-api, sw-vps, sw-expo, sw-capacitor, sw-tauri, sw-electron), its rules skill adds stack-specific rules on top of these.

## Integrations (INT)

APIs, emails and external services.

Applies when: Calls to external APIs or services.

Rules:

- Isolate each external service behind a single module: one place to change if the service changes.
- Validate external API responses like user input.
- Verify every webhook signature and process each event only once (idempotency).
- Emails: authenticated domain (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), text version, unsubscribe link for marketing.

Done means:

- [BLOCKER] INT-01: Webhook signatures verified (only if: has_webhooks). Check: webhooks.json: every endpoint declared in project.json › webhooks refuses an unsigned event and a wrongly signed one (4xx, never 2xx or 5xx). Also read the code: the signature is verified on the raw body before any processing.
- [major] INT-02: Webhook events processed only once (only if: has_webhooks). Check: Event ID stored; a replay creates no duplicate.
- [major] INT-03: External responses validated and service outages handled. Check: Schema on responses; degraded behaviour when the service is down.
- [major] INT-04: Emails authenticated (SPF, DKIM, DMARC) and not flagged as spam (only if: has_email). Check: DNS records checked; test send to Gmail and Outlook.
- [minor] INT-05: Each external service isolated in a dedicated module. Check: No direct SDK calls scattered across the code.
- [minor] INT-06: API quotas and terms of use respected. Check: Known limits, response caching, required attribution shown.

## Payments (PAY)

Billing, subscriptions and cancellation.

Applies when: Payments or subscriptions.

Rules:

- Use a hosted payment page (Stripe Checkout or equivalent): no card data goes through our servers.
- Payment or subscription state comes from the provider's webhook, never from the browser redirect.
- The displayed and charged price comes from the server or provider, never from a client-sent value.
- Cancelling is as simple as subscribing and reachable from the account.
- Test in test mode: success, decline, 3-D Secure, renewal failure, refund.

Done means:

- [BLOCKER] PAY-01: Access is granted only after confirmation by a signed webhook. Check: No access unlocked on the return page or through a URL parameter.
- [BLOCKER] PAY-02: The amount cannot be changed by the client. Check: Prices are read server-side (price IDs), never taken from the request.
- [major] PAY-03: Self-service cancellation, as simple as subscribing. Check: Cancellation flow from the account, no mandatory contact.
- [major] PAY-04: Payment failures and renewals handled. Check: Declined card, 3-D Secure, renewal failure: consistent access and emails.
- [major] PAY-05: Compliant invoices issued and accessible. Check: Invoices with the mentions required by the country, downloadable by the customer.
- [minor] PAY-06: Price, taxes, commitment and renewal shown before payment. Check: Clear summary before confirming.

## Costs (CST)

Spending control.

Rules:

- Keep the list of paid services with their monthly cost and what drives it up.
- Spending cap or alert on every usage-billed service (AI APIs, email sending, storage, bandwidth).
- Any user-triggered call to a paid service is authenticated and rate-limited.

Done means:

- [major] CST-01: Spending caps or alerts on usage-billed services (only if: uses_paid_services). Check: Budget or alert configured at each provider.
- [major] CST-02: No public route that triggers an unlimited cost (only if: uses_paid_services). Check: Routes to paid APIs: authentication, rate limiting, caching.
- [minor] CST-03: Up-to-date cost inventory. Check: File listing services, cost, billing basis, renewal date.
- [minor] CST-04: Unused resources removed. Check: Servers, databases, domains, subscriptions with no use.
